introHtml: Spray hand sanitizer offers a quick, no-rub application that dries fast—ideal for high-traffic areas like office lobbies, event check-ins, or manufacturing floors. Unlike gels, sprays cover larger surface areas in one pump, making them a practical choice for safety managers and HR directors prioritizing hygiene compliance. Customize 1 oz bullet sprays or credit card-shaped sprayers with your logo using pad printing or full-color labels. Perfect for branded giveaways that keep hands clean on the go.
